people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty in Baal, he died.
translations.bsb: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he was exalted in Israel. But he incurred guilt through Baal, and he died.
translations.kjv: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
translations.asv: When Ephraim spake, there was trembling; he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
